Street guide

A small field guide for Korea

Read the signs you’ll meet on the street

Before reaching for a translation app, look for the place word on the sign. 약국 means pharmacy, 카페 means café, and 편의점 means convenience store. These beginner-friendly guides explain the Hangul, pronunciation and clues you can use on your next walk.

Pharmacy signs: 약국

Learn the word for pharmacy and tell a pharmacy sign from a clinic sign.

Convenience stores: 편의점

Recognize the everyday word for a Korean convenience store.

Café signs: 카페

Read 카페, hear how it sounds and notice a few common café clues.

Finding your way: 출구 and 입구

Start with useful direction words for station entrances, exits and transfers.

SignToki’s shopfronts are fictional learning examples. They do not represent a particular business. Browse all Korean street-sign guides →
